author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: No original on production, so the current drawing was the reference. Before: triangular ears on a round U face with a small heart-shaped nose read as a cat. After: the same tall pointed ears over a broad cranium, but the face steps in to a boxy muzzle with a solid nose, which reads as a dog (shepherd/doberman head).
omissions: Mouth lines are left out: under the nose there's no room for 8 clearance to the chin.
